phase_1.title: Phase 1 · FN MAG / M240B Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 7.62×51mm NATO primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 415 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 415 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 627 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 4-groove bore and accelerates to 853 m/s (3455 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Long-Stroke Unlock & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 100-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the FN MAG / M240B staged for its 650–950 RPM (3-position gas-regulated cadence) cadence.

zh.headline: FN MAG / M240B 通用机枪：1958 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 比利时设计师欧内斯特·韦尔维耶打造的 FN MAG（美军编号 M240B、英军编号 L7A2）堪称集大成之作：它把勃朗宁 BAR 的倒置下摆刚性闭锁机构与德国 MG 42 的流畅双爪拨弹顶盖完美嫁接，在美军严苛测试中以平均无故障逾 26,000 发震撼业界。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：FN MAG / M240B 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1958 年问世的 FN MAG / M240B 通用机枪 由比利时 / 美国比利时 FN Herstal / 美国 FN America主导研制，定位为经典的通用机枪。1958 年问世的 FN MAG 至今已装备全球 80 余国，美军在 1990 年代以 M240B 全面取代 M60 步兵通用机枪，同时也是 M1A2 艾布拉姆斯主战坦克的并列机枪。
比利时设计师欧内斯特·韦尔维耶打造的 FN MAG（美军编号 M240B、英军编号 L7A2）堪称集大成之作：它把勃朗宁 BAR 的倒置下摆刚性闭锁机构与德国 MG 42 的流畅双爪拨弹顶盖完美嫁接，在美军严苛测试中以平均无故障逾 26,000 发震撼业界。 整件装备总长 1,245 mm（含消焰器与折叠两脚架）、空重 12.29 kg，成为同期通用机枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1958 年，比利时 / 美国比利时 FN Herstal / 美国 FN America推出了划时代的FN MAG / M240B 通用机枪。1958 年问世的 FN MAG 至今已装备全球 80 余国，美军在 1990 年代以 M240B 全面取代 M60 步兵通用机枪，同时也是 M1A2 艾布拉姆斯主战坦克的并列机枪。 它的核心设计聚焦于「BAR 闭锁 + MG 42 供弹」混血经典，双机械优势叠加成就恐怖平均无故障寿命，奠定了其在通用机枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: FN MAG / M240B 通用机枪 的机械灵魂在于其「下置长行程导气活塞 · BAR 系下摆闭锁杠杆 + MG 42 系凸轮弹链拨弹」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，长行程导气活塞带动枪机框完成自由行程并驱动旋转闭锁解锁，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用磷酸锰军规磷化钢精加工而成。3 档外置泄气式导气调节环可在 650–950 发/分之间随污垢与环境灵活调速，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。FN MAG / M240B 通用机枪 采用下置长行程导气活塞 · BAR 系下摆闭锁杠杆 + MG 42 系凸轮弹链拨弹。在每个击发周期中，长行程导气活塞带动枪机框完成自由行程并驱动旋转闭锁解锁。借助磷酸锰军规磷化钢工艺与高强度配合，实现了3 档外置泄气式导气调节环可在 650–950 发/分之间随污垢与环境灵活调速。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 7.62×51mm NATO 弹药规格与 627 mm 快换镀铬重枪管（4 条右旋膛线 · 305 mm / 1:12 缠距），最高工作膛压约 415 MPa，可赋予弹头 853 m/s 的出膛初速与 3,455 J 动能，有效作用距离达 1100 米。
内膛技术特点方面，厚壁快换枪管与液压后坐缓冲器组合，1,100 米区域压制精度极高。同时，M240B 配备热护木、顶部皮卡汀尼导轨与枪托液压缓冲器，显著改善连发可控性，令其在 650–950 发/分（3 档导气阀可调射速） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 627 毫米身管与 7.62×51mm NATO 口径，FN MAG / M240B 通用机枪 实现了每秒 853 米的初速与 1100 米有效射程。厚壁快换枪管与液压后坐缓冲器组合，1,100 米区域压制精度极高，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 100 发容量的弹链受弹盘与挂弹箱体与 49 mm 膛轴设计，FN MAG / M240B 通用机枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 11 N·s 水平。铆接钢板重型机匣与左侧 5 秒快拆枪管锁扣专为主战坦克并列与步兵重压制而生。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-51）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 100 发容量的弹链受弹盘与挂弹箱体与出色的整体工效，铆接钢板重型机匣与左侧 5 秒快拆枪管锁扣专为主战坦克并列与步兵重压制而生。欢迎在 BAY-51 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 FN MAG / M240B 通用机枪 的机械魅力。

en.headline: FN MAG / M240B: The 1958 Mechanical Legend
en.deck: Ernest Vervier’s FN MAG (U.S. M240B / UK L7A2) fuses an inverted Browning BAR dropping locking lever with an MG 42-style twin-pawl belt feed—achieving over 26,000 mean rounds between stoppages in U.S. military trials. Preserved in 1:1 interactive 3D CAD scale across all 20 functional assemblies in BAY-51.

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the FN MAG / M240B
paragraphs: Introduced in 1958 by FN Herstal / FN America in Belgium / United States, the FN MAG / M240B emerged as a defining General-Purpose Machine Gun. Adopted by over 80 nations since 1958, the FN MAG replaced the M60 as the U.S. Army’s M240B infantry GPMG and serves coaxially aboard the M1A2 Abrams.

Ernest Vervier’s FN MAG (U.S. M240B / UK L7A2) fuses an inverted Browning BAR dropping locking lever with an MG 42-style twin-pawl belt feed—achieving over 26,000 mean rounds between stoppages in U.S. military trials. Measuring 1,245 mm (With Flash Hider & Folding Bipod) at an unloaded weight of 12.29 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Machine Gun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1958, FN Herstal / FN America of Belgium / United States introduced the FN MAG / M240B. Adopted by over 80 nations since 1958, the FN MAG replaced the M60 as the U.S. Army’s M240B infantry GPMG and serves coaxially aboard the M1A2 Abrams. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Fuses BAR-derived rigid locking with MG 42-derived smooth twin-pawl belt feeding — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the FN MAG / M240B sits its Under-Barrel Long-Stroke Gas Piston · BAR Dropping Locking Lever & MG 42 Belt Feed. Throughout every firing cycle, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt, containing 415 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in manganese-phosphate Parkerized ordnance steel, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, 3-position exhaust gas regulator tunes cyclic rate from 650 to 950 RPM under fouling, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The FN MAG / M240B relies on Under-Barrel Long-Stroke Gas Piston · BAR Dropping Locking Lever & MG 42 Belt Feed. During each cycle, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt. Machined from manganese-phosphate Parkerized ordnance steel, it delivers standout engineering reliability: 3-position exhaust gas regulator tunes cyclic rate from 650 to 950 RPM under fouling.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 7.62×51mm NATO with 627 mm Quick-Change Chrome-Lined Barrel (4-Groove RH · 1:12" Twist), the FN MAG / M240B develops 853 m/s muzzle velocity and 3,455 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 1100 meters.

Internally, Heavy quick-change barrel and hydraulic buffer deliver exceptionally steady 1,100 m suppression. Combined with its 650–950 RPM (3-position gas-regulated cadence) tempo, M240B adds a heat shield, top Picatinny rail, and hydraulic buttstock buffer, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 7.62×51mm NATO through its 627 millimeter bore, the FN MAG / M240B achieves 853 meters per second and 1100 meters of effective reach. Heavy quick-change barrel and hydraulic buffer deliver exceptionally steady 1,100 m suppression.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 100-round ammunition belt feed tray & box with a 49 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 11 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Heavy riveted steel receiver serves identically as an infantry GPMG and MBT coaxial gun.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-51), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
acts.audioScript: Act Four: Engineering Legacy. Pairing its 100-round ammunition belt feed tray & box with disciplined recoil geometry, Heavy riveted steel receiver serves identically as an infantry GPMG and MBT coaxial gun. Explore BAY-51 in live section cut and exploded disassembly to study every working link of the FN MAG / M240B.
